span.p: F-D11-035 Legacy Next BFF·로그 API·요청본문 helper

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
div.span: 1. route 내부는 authorizeProxyRequest 후 upstream header와 bounded body를 준비한다

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
div.span: 2. detect는 image admission 획득 후 bounded multipart를 전달하고 finally에서 release한다

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
div.span: 3. JSON helper는 content type·declared/actual bytes·UTF8·JSON을 검사한다

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
div.span: 4. AbortSignal은 request disconnect와10초 body-read timer를 결합한다

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
div.span: 5. API handler 결과를 no-store 형태로 전달한다
